name: lodgemaster-scrapper-function
description: lodge104-lodgemaster-scrapper Lambda handler. Deliberately has no production dependencies: @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb and @aws-sdk/client-ssm are provided by the Lambda Node.js runtime, and puppeteer-core/@sparticuz/chromium are provided by the PuppeteerLayer (see ../layer). type: module is required because puppeteer-core >=22 and @sparticuz/chromium >=130 ship as pure ES modules with no CommonJS build.
